line: Checked November 19, 2026: all 48 checks passed, against the committed draws (study/results/raw_replication.csv.gz), the February run’s results, the study’s own matrix code, and the paper’s printed numbers.

checks.name: the tickets are the study's seeds 0 to 99, one each (study/results/raw_replication.csv.gz)
the data sets are the study's five, in its order, with the file's test-set sizes
each data set's feature count d equals its data file's columns
every ticket's accuracies equal the file, value for value (4,000 values)
every matrix's count of zero columns and zero rows equals the file, the same on all four kernel rows (1,000 matrices)
the kernels are the file's four, in the order the plate reads them
the report's draw is ticket 42: the only one whose 40 accuracies equal the February run's committed results (results/original_run_20260213_172002)
study/replicate.py names the same seed as the report's draw, and the same split seed and k as the plate
each median on the board equals study/results/replication_summary.csv
and equals the median of the 100 best accuracies in the file (the summary keeps six significant digits)
the paper's numbers in the data equal paper/numbers.tex
the data names the files it was read from
every stored share is a whole number of correct test rows, to the file's six decimals (4,000 shares)
the kernels named under each value are exactly those reaching the best in the file (1,000 cells)
every ticket's lead on each data set and its verdict equal the independent reading (500 leads, 100 verdicts)
the verdict counts over all 100 draws: 52 the report's headline, 43 the opposite, 5 neither
52 of the 100 draws put Eq. 4 strictly ahead on three or more data sets, as the paper prints (rep3:ge3 = 52)
the report's draw gives the report's headline: Eq. 4 ahead on 3 of 5
ticket 42's values equal the paper's: Table II's 40 cells (table_original.tex), Table III's report column (table_replication.tex), and the five differences o:<ds>:delta (50 fields)
ticket 42's Iris Eq. 4 is 68.9% under every kernel, as the paper prints (o:iris:eq4:linear)
on Seeds, the report's Eq. 4 value 92.1% is above 92, ties 3, and is below 4 of the other 99, as the paper prints
the report's ticket stands among the other 99 where replication_summary.csv records, on every data set and matrix (10 rows)
the test-set sizes and one row's worth of points equal numbers.tex (Iris and Glass)
every ticket's standing among the other 99 equals an independent count (1,000 standings)
Iris's Eq. 4 matrix had a whole column of zeros in 30 of the 100 draws (25 with one, 5 with both), counted from the file
no Eq. 3 matrix in the file has a zero row or a zero column
on the board, tickets with the same accuracy stack in ticket order, each stack as tall as its count, and the axis covers every value
pulls take each of the 100 tickets with equal chance (chi-square over 1,000,000 pulls; 148.2 is the 0.1% critical value for 99 degrees of freedom)
a pull sequence repeats exactly from its seed (10,000 pulls)
shares round half up to one decimal as paper/make_numbers.py does (81,003 shares)
every Eq. 4 minus Eq. 3 difference on a ticket rounds as the paper's sgn1 does on the file's values (500 differences)
the zero counts in the file are what the study's own matrix code gives (scripts/random_projection.py, seeds 0 to 99, 1,000 matrices)
Eq. 3's entries are never zero (every Eq. 3 matrix the study's code draws for these seeds)
every ticket's sentence on which matrix leads names exactly the data sets the file gives each (100 tickets)
every verdict sentence carries the ticket's counts and the right conclusion
every stamp states the verdict and its count
every zero sentence gives each data set's zero rows out of its d, and exactly the data sets with zero columns (one or both)
the kernels under each value, the ticket number, and the heading read the ticket
every branch of the ticket's sentences occurs among the 100 tickets (17 branches)
every standing sentence reads the value and counts the other 99 (1,000 sentences)
every running count and its sentences carry the pulls' counts and shares beside all 100 and the theory (400 simulated runs, every branch: yes)
the running count holds each of the reader's pulls and none of the 11,720 the drum makes on its own (200 simulated runs)
at a seed, the reader's pulls come in the same order whatever the drum does on its own (20,489 pulls among 3,604 of the drum's own pulls and returns, 200 seeds)

the address's seed is its decimal digits, read exactly and taken modulo 2^32, and anything else is no seed (18 addresses: ?seed=9007199254740993 is seed 1, ?seed=4294967296 and ?seed=0 are seed 0, and ?seed=7abc, -0, 42.5, and 6e3 are none); the plate's ?seed= link reads back as the same seed and pulls (403 links), read and written in the view by these functions

"Clear the pulls" during a pull holds, on the built view: after Draw once or Draw 20 and a clear before the ticket lands, both labels say "no pulls of yours" and the count is 0 once the flight ends, and the next pull is counted alone (at ?seed=4294967296, which links ?seed=0)
the empty bar of your pulls and the Iris count beside it are the model's labels, which say "no pulls of yours" after a reset or the drum's own pulls (no "yet")
the chapter page carries the plate, its data file, and its script
the model checked here is the one in the site's source
